mapper.select: SELECT USER_NO, GOAL_WEIGHT, GOAL_FAT, GOAL_SMM, GOAL_CALORIE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT, GOAL_CALORIE_MORNING, GOAL_CALORIE_LUNCH, GOAL_CALORIE_DINNER, GOAL_CALORIE_ETC FROM GOAL_TBL WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo}
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO GOAL_TBL G USING DUAL ON (G.USER_NO = #{userNo}) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET GOAL_WEIGHT = #{goalWeight}, GOAL_FAT = #{goalFat}, GOAL_SMM = #{goalSmm}, GOAL_CALORIE = NULL, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( USER_NO, GOAL_WEIGHT, GOAL_FAT, GOAL_SMM, GOAL_CALORIE, CREATED_AT, UPDATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{userNo}, #{goalWeight}, #{goalFat}, #{goalSmm}, NULL, SYSTIMESTAMP, SYSTIMESTAMP )
mapper.update: UPDATE GOAL_TBL SET GOAL_WEIGHT = #{goalWeight, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, GOAL_FAT = #{goalFat, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, GOAL_SMM = #{goalSmm, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, GOAL_CALORIE = #{goalCalorie, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, GOAL_CALORIE_MORNING = #{goalCalorieMorning, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, GOAL_CALORIE_LUNCH = #{goalCalorieLunch, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, GOAL_CALORIE_DINNER = #{goalCalorieDinner, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, GOAL_CALORIE_ETC = #{goalCalorieEtc, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, GOAL_CALORIE_ACTIVITY_DAILY = #{goalCalorieActivityDaily, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, GOAL_ACTIVITY_TIME = #{goalActivityTime, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, UPDATED_AT = SYSTIMESTAMP WHERE USER_NO = #{userNo}
